// Generated by Love Radar's native generator; edit the repo template instead.
package __PACKAGE__;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.IBinder;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Keeps an explicitly accepted, active WebRTC call's Android process alive.
 * It does NOT record audio itself, and does not claim to keep a suspended
 * WebView media stream running on every device. */
public class NativeCallService extends Service {
    private static final int NOTIFICATION_ID = 2927;
    private static final String CHANNEL_ID = "love_radar_ongoing_call";
    private static final String CALL_ENDPOINT = "https://love-radar-acd.pages.dev/api/call";
    private final ScheduledExecutorService scheduler =
        Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
    private ScheduledFuture<?> heartbeat;
    private volatile String activeId;
    private volatile String activeToken;

    @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return null; }

    @Override public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        String id = intent.getStringExtra("id");
        String token = intent.getStringExtra("token");
        if (id == null || !id.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}") ||
            token == null || !token.matches("[a-f0-9]{64}")) {
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        // Restrict foreground microphone service to calls started by a
        // visible app after the WebRTC microphone permission is granted.
        try {
            ensureChannel();
            Notification notification = buildNotification();
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
                startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification,
                    ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        activeId = id;
        activeToken = token;
        if (heartbeat != null) heartbeat.cancel(false);
        heartbeat = scheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(
            this::sendHeartbeat, 1, 24, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        NotificationChannel channel = new NotificationChannel(
            CHANNEL_ID, "Appels Love Radar", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
        channel.setDescription("Affiche un appel audio en cours");
        NotificationManager manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager.class);
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel);
    }

    private Notification buildNotification() {
        Intent openApp = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        openApp.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP);
        int flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT;
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) flags |= PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE;
        PendingIntent click = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 0, openApp, flags);
        Notification.Builder builder =
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O
            ? new Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
            : new Notification.Builder(this);
        return builder.setContentTitle("Love Radar · Appel audio")
            .setContentText("Appuie pour revenir à la conversation")
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.sym_call_incoming)
            .setContentIntent(click)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
            .setCategory(Notification.CATEGORY_CALL)
            .build();
    }

    private void sendHeartbeat() {
        final String id = activeId, token = activeToken;
        if (id == null || token == null) return;
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(CALL_ENDPOINT).openConnection();
            connection.setRequestMethod("POST");
            connection.setConnectTimeout(5500);
            connection.setReadTimeout(5500);
            connection.setDoOutput(true);
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
            connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
            String payload = "{\"action\":\"heartbeat\",\"id\":\"" + id + "\"}";
            try (OutputStream out = connection.getOutputStream()) {
                out.write(payload.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }
            int status = connection.getResponseCode();
            // Server ended the call / invalidated the session: remove the
            // foreground notification and stop native background traffic.
            if ((status == 401 || status == 409) && id.equals(activeId)) {
                stopSelf();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Transient mobile disconnections are retried. Server expiry still
            // prevents a dead call from being prolonged forever.
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    @Override public void onDestroy() {
        activeId = null;
        activeToken = null;
        if (heartbeat != null) heartbeat.cancel(true);
        scheduler.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}
